name: Versatility
description: +1 prepared slot, and companion-granted spells cost no off-caster tax. Breadth over signature.

name: Minor Working
description: Choose one: heal 3 health, see what one site within 4 tiles is, or take no terrain damage for 3 tiles.

name: Emulate
description: Recast the last spell cast this expedition at its cost +1. Inherits the original's magnitude and echoes.

name: Attuned Recall
description: Return at once to the tile where you arrived. No days pass.
